hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json, sys; data = json.load(sys.stdin); cmd = data.get("tool_input", {}).get("CommandLine", ""); blocked = ["terraform destroy", "kubectl delete namespace", "kubectl delete --all", "helm uninstall"]; sys.exit(2) if any(b in cmd for b in blocked) else sys.exit(0)'
hooks.description: Block destructive infrastructure and cluster deletion commands
